reviewer_note: Read in full only items-author.json (48 items), the 13 contracts in .worktrees/netzoo-core-p0-run/workflows/*.yaml and .worktrees/netzoo-core-p0-run/scripts/workflow_registry.py (all 2,676 lines: controls, output capabilities, conventions, input_checks, CLAIM_SUPPORT, UNSUPPORTED_CLAIMS, EXTERNAL_REFERENCES, REQUEST_CONCERNS). Nothing else was opened and the assistant was not run. Each gold was checked against the verbatim contract text: class, workflow set (for do: fitting workflows missing or extra), deciding fact or missing core. Limits were recomputed by hand: sample minimums (LIONESS-PANDA/PUMA/COEXPRESSION, BONOBO, LIONESS-DRAGON >= 3), OTTER lam in [0, 1], gamma >= 0, iterations >= 1, BONOBO delta in (0, 1/3) with sparsify, SAMBAR 2 <= kmin <= kmax <= samples, COBRA genes > samples, DRAGON two layers and both lambdas in [0, 1], GIRAFFE controls: []. LIONESS-DRAGON values = n(n-1)/2 feature pairs over both layers x samples; every verdict is the same if the diagonal is counted (n(n+1)/2): J11 17,970,000 (18,030,000), J14 11,235,000 vs 460,704,000, J19 3,670,800, J20 187,425,000, J29 11,500,800, against the 20,000,000 cap. file_checkable is set only for ask items of form run (J09, J21, J34, J37); null elsewhere. No gold was changed; borderline points are noted in reason.

J01.reason: 'Understand gene regulation' and 'any thoughts on how to approach it' name no result; the missing core is right. The candidate list is only indicative for a vague item.

J02.reason: GIRAFFE exposes no controls, so learning rate, iterations and the PPI loss weight cannot be set. The registry also says the agent sets none of these.
J02.evidence: giraffe.yaml: "controls: []" | giraffe.yaml: "the agent calls only the required three positional arrays and uses the package defaults for all optional parameters." | workflow_registry.py (REQUEST_CONCERNS run_giraffe): "How far it moves is set by the optimizer's learning rate, its iteration limits and the loss weights, none of which this agent sets"

J03.reason: PANDA takes coexpression_file while keeping expression_file, and with_header is its control. Whether the COBRA matrix's gene IDs and order match is a file-level check, not a request-level limit. PUMA and OTTER also accept COBRA's artifact, but the user names PANDA and uses its with_header control.
J03.evidence: panda.yaml: "optional_inputs: [with_header, coexpression_file, taxon]" | panda.yaml: "When coexpression_file is supplied, it must be a labeled symmetric gene-by-gene matrix whose IDs and dimensions match PANDA's filtered gene axis."

J04.evidence: otter.yaml: "This agent's registered OTTER action is aggregate only and does not silently label its output LIONESS-OTTER." | workflow_registry.py (EXTERNAL_REFERENCES LIONESS-OTTER): "netZooPy, not registered in this agent"
